lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters are organized into approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gills, transitioning from a dense, randomized distribution on the head to a structured grid on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, aligned with the columns of high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like intersection pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance contrast between the illuminated dorsal side and the shadowed ventral side of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated, low-reflectance silhouettes (commensal organisms) trailing from the ventral surface and posterior to the pectoral fin.
